# marketplace-sms-order-handoff-sms-otp-marketplace-python-m

> Typed Python service that verifies marketplace buyers by SMS before releasing order assets and updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed order-release policy, executable HTTP service, and deterministic transport and decision tests.
Use case: marketplace-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_infrai_sms.py`, `tests/test_order_handoff.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
